notes: Self-storage REIT, so it fits the financials sector loosely; fee income from managed properties is only partly evidenced.

financial_business_type.detail: Real estate investment trust that owns, operates, manages and develops self-storage facilities in the US and Canada.

revenue_driver.detail: Month-to-month storage unit rental income, plus management fees from managed properties.

customer_type.detail: Individuals, students and military renters, plus businesses storing inventory, files and equipment.

balance_sheet_dependence.detail: Owns and develops a large portfolio of storage properties, with some third-party managed.
